title: Cross-Extrapolative Beliefs: Evidence from Equity Analysts
eligible_reason: Treatment is a continuous, recurring quarterly news shock: forecasts regressed on beliefShock / OCFNews (value-weighted news at the analyst's other coverage firms) or its decile dummies D1-D10 with stock x quarter and analyst x stock FE and controls (9_mainAnalysis.do). Not an absorbing binary adoption. The 2014-15 oil-price shock regressions (treated coverOil postEvent, absorb(stockQuarter)) use a single event date. No staggered binary design.
design_notes: Analyst-stock-quarter panel (I/B/E/S, CRSP, Compustat) testing cross-extrapolation of earnings news across an analyst's coverage portfolio; outcomes forecast errors, optimism/pessimism, recommendations, LTG, revisions, CARs, dispersion, career moves.
data_files_note: Code/Readme.docx: requires CRSP, Compustat, I/B/E/S (WRDS licenses); package contains code only, no data files.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Continuous news exposure; no data shipped.
